tonight.headline: You dropped Coker, not Fairbairn
body: Bad news first: the Commanders D/ST went in at 15:13Z, but the drop was Jalen Coker — healthy and off the Panthers' injury report — not Fairbairn, the second kicker on a bye. The lineup was then reset with Metcalf in the flex and Gordon benched.
ESPN projects AVIATO 128.1 to 88.7, 70%. Two things to do: claim Coker back for Fairbairn before Wed 4 Nov 02:00, and put Gordon in the flex over Metcalf before Sunday 12:00 — 130.3 projected.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Guillo-tinas start Kittle on a 49ers bye and bench Nacua (22.5) and Lamar Jackson (22.4, expected to play per Rapoport). Set properly they are around 120 — still behind AVIATO set properly.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Guillo-tinas fixing their lineup and AVIATO not: about 120 to 128 — close enough that the 2.2-point flex call is worth making.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claim clears Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX — he misses Week 8 either way
doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: The D/ST add dropped Coker instead of the kicker on bye. He is healthy, on waivers, and Fairbairn cannot score for you.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Jalen Coker. This morning's card said drop Fairbairn — a second kicker, on a Houston bye. AVIATO still carry two kickers, and Coker is on Chem waivers until Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX.

case.label: The player
case.body: Coker's shoulder designation was removed from the Panthers' final report on Wednesday; he plays at Green Bay on Thursday (NBC 28 Oct, Yahoo 28 Oct). 13 targets in Week 6, 4 in Week 7 (archive). Ranked WR16 this week.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn cannot start while Bass kicks; Chem starts one kicker and streams it (STRATEGY §5). This is an exception to the churn rule, stated: the rule stops a considered decision being reversed, and nothing in the activity log or the morning brief makes this drop a decision — the plan was the other player.

case.label: The clock
case.body: He misses Week 8 whatever happens — the claim clears after his Thursday game. Chem priority resets weekly but AVIATO are 10th, so any rival who claims him wins; 90% of ESPN leagues roster him.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive) — then the receiver room did not need him back. If the drop was deliberate and the owner knows something no report says, skip the claim.

doFirst.sources: League file activity 15:13Z · NBC 28 Oct · Yahoo 28 Oct · archive

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Sun 1 Nov 12:00 CDMX — Metcalf's kickoff
doFirst.title: Start Ollie Gordon II in the flex, bench DK Metcalf
doFirst.subtitle: The lineup check's one change: Gordon 14.4, Metcalf 12.2. No unpriced news on either.

case.label: The gap
case.body: lineup_check.py: Gordon 14.4, Metcalf 12.2 — 2.2 points, labelled PROJECTION, just outside the coin-flip line. The lineup was reset at 15:17-15:19Z with Metcalf in the flex.

case.label: Gordon
case.body: Miami's starter since Achane's ACL; a rushing TD in four straight games (WFLX 28 Oct). Not on Wednesday's report; Malik Willis practised fully (Patriots.com 28 Oct). 25 carries in Week 7 (archive).

case.label: Metcalf
case.body: Rodgers' top downfield option but 2 catches on 6 targets in Week 7 (Fantasy Footballers 25 Oct). Pittman's IR stint is already in his 12.2. No unpriced news on either side, so the projection decides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Gordon in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome.

whatWentWrong.title: The defence add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: 15:13Z: Commanders D/ST in, Jalen Coker out. The card said Fairbairn.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Second day running a drop processed on the wrong player: this morning the Bass claim took the Broncos D/ST instead of Fairbairn; this afternoon the D/ST add took Coker. Fairbairn — on bye, a second kicker — survived both.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Coker claim above. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting; the risk is a rival claiming him first.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Coker drop was deliberate — then skip the claim and say why, so the next run stops recommending it.

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup reset put Metcalf in the flex
whatWentWrong.lead: 15:17-15:19Z: Gordon to the bench, Metcalf to the flex — 2.2 projected points given up.

case.label: What happened
case.body: With Coker gone, the flex went to Metcalf rather than Gordon. Gap 2.2 by lineup_check.py.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The swap card above. Metcalf locks first (Sun 12:00), so make it before then.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Gordon in Week 8 (archive).
